highlights: Movement keys, Jump, and Open Chat now use the same key-capture widget as hotkeys
Fixed 'ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty' error when downloading updates
HUD falls back to the built-in renderer if the Electron HUD process fails to launch
Hints in the config editor now reflect your current keybinds
Fixed incorrect default hotkey hints (editor was showing F6/F5 instead of Alt+C/Alt+D)
Hotkey tooltips now consistently show Alt+<key> matching the AHK binding
